faq.a1: Raspberry and lemon. Natural flavours, no earthy greens aftertaste. Zero sugar.
faq.a2: Yes. 0.0 g sugars per serving and per 100 g. Sweetness comes from polyols with stevia and thaumatin.
faq.a3: Sugar-free polyols, plus stevia and thaumatin. No sugar, no artificial colours. The green comes from black carrot extract.
faq.q4: How many gummies are in one daily pack?
faq.a4: One pack is one serving: 5 gummies (14 g).
faq.a5: Whenever you'll remember. Morning, desk, train, 3pm. It needs no water, so it fits wherever your day is.
faq.a7: 39 active ingredients: 8 greens, 8 fruits and vegetables, 21 vitamins and minerals, prebiotic inulin, and Bacillus coagulans live cultures (5 billion CFU per serving). The full ingredient list and nutrition information are under 'What's inside' above.
faq.a8: Fora uses a pectin base, not gelatin.
faq.q9: Does it contain gluten, dairy or nuts?
faq.a9: No. Fora is free from all 14 declarable allergens, including gluten-containing cereals, milk, peanuts, tree nuts, soya, eggs, fish, crustaceans, molluscs, celery, mustard, sesame, sulphites and lupin.
faq.q10: Can I pause or cancel my subscription?
faq.a10: Yes. Pause, skip or cancel any time from your account. No phone call required. You'll get a reminder before every charge.
faq.a11: Your order will arrive within 3 working days. If you subscribe, you'll also get free UK delivery on every order.
faq.a12: Try your first pack properly. If Fora isn't for you, contact us within 28 days.
faq.a13: Fora is a food supplement for adults. Do not exceed the stated recommended daily dose. Food supplements should not be used as a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Keep out of reach of young children. Excessive consumption may produce laxative effects. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, on medication or have a medical condition, speak to your GP first.
faq.a14: In its tightly closed original packaging, in a cool, dry place below 25°C and away from direct sunlight. Shelf life is 24 months from the date of manufacture.
faq.q15: Do I need to take anything else alongside Fora?
faq.a15: Fora is designed as a daily nutrition backup, not a replacement for food.
